name: Miko Miko Rumble
source:
Shuji loves miko! He can't live without miko! One day, he is luckily transferred to a miko high school. But, the students are far from what he imagined. He gets mad, and has various quarrels against them. Somehow, they gradually fall in love with him, and a battle for him breaks out!
